observations: Photo 0: cream/tan colored mechanical sewing machine, side view, needle down threading red thread through folded fabric sample.
Photo 0: a small yellowish stain/mark visible on the top casing near the bobbin winder area.
Photo 0: partial German text visible on the front panel ('Für Gebrauch...Bedienungsanleitung lesen') but no brand or model name legible.
Photo 1: same machine from the opposite side, showing the handwheel, balance wheel, and tension dials; a hand is holding the handwheel.
No foot pedal, power cord plug, or manual is clearly shown in either photo.
Machine sits on a dark blue cloth; wires in the background appear to be unrelated power cords, not clearly the machine's own cord.
No visible stitching sample on actual fabric beyond the test strip threaded through the needle.

claims.claim: Like a brand new machine, wasn't really used
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a visible stain/mark on the top casing, inconsistent with an unused, pristine machine.

claims.claim: Just buy and use (implying fully functional)
claims.evidence: No video or photo shows the machine actually sewing through fabric layers, only a needle threaded with a test strip.

risks.risk: Motor and stitching mechanism may not work properly (skipped stitches, jammed bobbin, weak motor).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine sewing a straight and zigzag line on a folded fabric piece.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing servicing

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as foot pedal, power cord, bobbins, or instruction manual, which affect usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full accessory set laid out together with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, accessories not included

risks.risk: Internal wear (belt, gears, tension spring) not visible from exterior photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo/video of the open internal compartment and a worn/new belt comparison.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown internal wear, same as used condition

risks.risk: Electrical safety of cord and plug (fraying, exposed wires) not shown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the power cord and plug end to end.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, deduct for potential rewiring cost

risks.risk: Unidentified brand/model means no confirmation of parts availability or original price tier.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any brand plate, nameplate, or serial number sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced generically as unbranded mechanical sewing machine

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing continuously through folded fabric, showing both straight and zigzag stitches.
Clear photo of any brand/model plate or serial number.
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cord, bobbins, manual) together.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug condition.
Photo of the open internal mechanism (belt, gears) if accessible.
response.reason: The item is clearly a generic mechanical sewing machine with no readable brand/model, and the seller's 'like new' claim is contradicted by a visible stain; since function is unproven, it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-condition machine of its type.
